pipeline.responsibility: Validate encoding, language tag, length, allowed characters and declared pronunciation profile without altering the input silently.
Apply explicit, versioned orthographic normalization operations while preserving the original text and an operation log.
Produce a profile-dependent phonetic representation with source spans, features, syllable boundaries, stress and certainty labels.
Project the phonetic sequence onto the representational constraints of the selected Northeastern Iberian model and controlled token inventory.
Generate every candidate retained by the active rule set, preserving ambiguity branches and rejecting empty silent output.
Calculate reproducible non-negative costs from versioned components and preserve exact ties or near-ties according to a declared policy.
Produce a human-readable trace for every normalization, adaptation, scoring and uncertainty decision without semantic claims.
Resolve tokens to controlled graphic references and report any missing resource without inventing or silently replacing a sign.

layers.description: Original user-supplied text and declared language/profile options.
Versioned orthographic normalization with a complete operation log.
Ordered units with symbols, feature bundles, source spans, syllable information, stress and certainty.
Explicit operations mapping phonetic units to controlled tokens, each linked to a rule, cost and evidence basis.
One or more candidates ordered by deterministic cost while preserving ties and uncertainty.
References to controlled local SVG resources; this layer cannot change linguistic content.

operation_types.semantics: Represent a source unit or licensed source group without feature loss under an approved rule.
Replace a source unit with the nearest approved representable class while recording changed features.
Insert a segment required by the writing-system model or an approved phonotactic repair.
Omit an unrepresentable source segment only under an explicit rule and blocking warning policy.
Associate a vowel with an occlusive series when required by the semisyllabic representation model.
Modify syllable grouping to satisfy an approved representational constraint while retaining an explicit trace.
Preserve two or more profile-dependent or rule-equivalent analyses as separate candidates.
Select a graphic variant only after the linguistic token sequence has been fixed and according to an explicit profile.

cost_model.zero_cost_policy: Only an approved exact_match may receive zero adaptation cost; graphic selection remains a separate layer.

invariants: The original input must remain recoverable and unchanged.
Every normalized layer must retain an ordered operation trace.
Every target token must exist in the version-bound minimum inventory.
Every rendered sign must reference a controlled asset from the version-bound manifest.
No phonetic or graphic similarity may create an Iberian semantic claim.
No unrepresentable source unit may disappear without an explicit operation and warning.
Equivalent-cost candidates must not be collapsed into an unqualified single answer.
Confidence must remain not_calibrated until the declared calibration gates are met.
Rule, cost, confidence, corpus, inventory, mapping and asset versions must be included in every result.
Rendering cannot alter the linguistic token sequence.

unresolved_decisions.question: Which European Spanish pronunciation profiles and optional contrasts will be represented without silently imposing one dialect?
Which exact IPA subset and feature vocabulary will be normative for internal phonetic units?
Which constraints are descriptive of the selected signary and which are explicit engineering approximations?
How will corpus evidence, comparative scholarship and engineering decisions be separated inside each rule?
Which non-negative weights and near-tie threshold can be justified and tested reproducibly?
When may a candidate select an attestation-specific allograph rather than the normalized reference layer?
Which evaluation set and external review are sufficient before confidence bands or numeric scores are exposed?
